title: Use missing_field_error to match or replace generic required-field errors from source config validation
answers: how to replace Required field ... is missing with a custom message for a source
where is the Required field error string built
filter required-field errors in a source validate_config
body:
common/config.py:missing_field_error(field_name) is the one place that builds the "Required field '<name>' is missing" string, and validate_config uses it.
A source that wants to suppress or reword those errors should build its match set from missing_field_error. BigQuery does this: _KEY_FILE_FIELD_ERRORS is built from dataclasses.fields(BigQueryAuthTypeConfigKeyFileConfig). Don't copy the literal string into the source.
Build the field list from the generated config dataclass (generated_configs/<source>), not a hand-written list, so it stays in sync when the generated config changes.
Tests check that no returned error contains "Required field". API tests in backend/tests/api/test_external_data_source.py check the user-facing message text, so update them when you change the copy.
applies: Any warehouse source overriding validate_config on top of the shared config walker
